name: Ookouchi Maria
source:
Maria is a sophomore, and it is surprising she was able to enter Koutenrin since she is not from a rich or famous family, and pushed away from her parents to enter the school. She is a very energetic and loud person, and also a bit of a trouble-maker, as her forceful attitude leads to fights. Her weak point is she is sensitive about her physical features, and her special ability is being mischievous.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/empusa/empusa.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
